title: The console page: four tabs, tooltips, forms, Spanish and English
acceptance_criteria: Build .harness/ui/index.html, app.js, styles.css, i18n/es.json and i18n/en.json as design section 7 specifies, against the API of section 6. No external requests of any kind, no build step, no frameworks.

Tabs Live, Operator, Society and Flows. Activity tooltip on every agent and task. Flow form editor with tracks as rows. Decision cards with choice buttons. Verdict, gate, commit and push buttons that send the token header. Copyable signature commands.
A demo mode (?demo) that renders realistic sample data shipped in .harness/ui/demo.json, so the page can be built and reviewed before the server exists; the real mode uses the API.
A static test, .harness/tests/test_console_ui.py: every i18n key exists in both languages, every key the page uses exists, and index.html, app.js and styles.css reference no other origin.
Edit only .harness/ui/ and that test. Run only your own test file. Hand off to verifier.

notes.note: Plan: index.html, styles.css, app.js (vanilla, i18n via data-i18n and t()), i18n es/en, demo.json for ?demo, static test.
